title: Built a diversified industrial conglomerate beginning with match
statement: Built a diversified industrial conglomerate beginning with match manufacturing, then expanding into cement, coal, and wool textiles.
outcome: Liu became one of Republican Shanghai's most prominent industrialists, with holdings across multiple sectors, per Wikipedia and Global Times profiles.

title: Remained on the mainland after 1949 and cooperated with the new
statement: Remained on the mainland after 1949 and cooperated with the new Communist government rather than relocating his business interests abroad.
outcome: Liu was granted protected 'nationalist capitalist' status by the CCP and served in national political bodies (NPC delegate, CPPCC member) until his death in 1956.
